Raise page_pool_size TOO: persist via poc/amd-rocm-bringup/config/ (kernel cmdline 'amdgpu.gttsize=-1 ttm.pages_limit=24641536 ttm.page_pool_size=24641536' or /etc/modprobe.d), update-grub/initramfs, reboot; then re-check. See poc/amd-rocm-bringup/TTM-RUNBOOK.md.
